known_information: Issue: ### Microsoft PowerToys version 0.97.2 ### Installation method Other (please specify in "Steps to Reproduce") ### Area(s) with issue? Mouse Without Borders ### Steps to reproduce Both Github & MS Store versions exhibit this behavior. I've uninstalled the Github install on both PCs then installed the MS Store versions - same behavior. Copy & paste text from one PC to the other fails after a number of times (~3 to 6) requiring closing out of PowerToys completely to work again. ### ✔️ Expected Behavior Copy text from webpage on one machine to the other. ### ❌ Actual Behavior Copy text from any webpage on one PC to paste into filename on the other PC works most times for ~3 to 6 times then just stops. Doesn't matter which direction, with mouse & keyboard from both PCs, it fails after a few times requiring closing out Powertoys completely and relaunching. Sometimes the keyboard shortcut to reconnect works for a few times then again stops, sometimes doesn't work at all. Never works without failing at some point ~10 times at best. ### Additional Information PC 1 Edition Windows 11 Pro Version 25H2 Installed on ‎11/‎11/‎2025 OS build 26200.7922 Experience Windows Feature Experience Pack 1000.26100.300.0 PC 2 Edition Windows 11 Pro Version 25H2 Installed on ‎11/‎11/‎2025 OS build 26200.7840 Experience Windows Feature Experience Pack 1000.26100.291.0 ### Other Software [PowerToysReport_2026-02-27-07-47-25.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25604748/PowerToysReport_2026-02-27-07-47-25.zip)

Comment by starfishpatkhoo: I just want to point out to all people who come to this issue, that this is in fact a **VERY OLD** problem. It was first reported in June 2023 in version 0.70.1, almost **3 YEARS** ago (as of today) in https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/26856 .. While I agree that duplicate issues should be closed, and I think all developers and users do appreciate the clean up, but please favour the oldest duplicate issue and not the newest. If you close all the old issues and leave only the newest one, you will: * Ignore the history and contributions made by all the past bug reporters who _DID_ put in the effort to search for old/past/duplicate issues. Or else, why bother to keep open issues hanging around at all then. * New people working on this problem may not realise the depth (there are observations, conditions, workarounds, etc, noted) and longevity of this issue because it appears to be something that only occurred very recently. Just my two cents. PS. It's funny because just yesterday, https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/28243 was closed in favour of https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/26856 .. so I know the concept of closing the newer duplicate issue in favour of the older/original issue is known. Unless there is like a good reason (please explain in detail if there is), please revert this issue closing action to better reflect the history of this bug...

Comment by mj34hig44: > This bug is off and on It's not though, if it works, it inevitably fails after 3 or 4 C&Ps. If you try to copy a phrase from one PC's browser, paste to a filename on the second then try to repeat that process, it will reliably fail before the count of 10. It's repeatable. It's what I need to do every day and I can assure you it's repeatable and frustrating AF. Even restarting PT on both PCs will result in the exact same failure. Add to this the ghost MWB desktop folder reported for at least as long as the clipboard issue and it's a sad fact that MWB is not and going by the handwriting on the wall, will never be ready for primetime.

Comment by starfishpatkhoo: > If you try to copy a phrase from one PC's browser, paste to a filename on the second then try to repeat that process, it will reliably fail before the count of 10. It's repeatable. It's what I need to do every day and I can assure you it's repeatable and frustrating AF. Even restarting PT on both PCs will result in the exact same failure. Have you tried the scripts in https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/26856 ? You don't need to restart the whole of PT, just run the script to restart that MWB component portion. And because you are restarting just a component of MWB, you didn't actually "lose" the MWB connection - no need to "re-connect", so it is a whole lot easier. (Which is why people should keep the history/old issues around instead of closing them as dupe just like that!) > Add to this the ghost MWB desktop folder reported for at least as long as the clipboard issue and it's a sad fact that MWB is not and going by the handwriting on the wall, will never be ready for primetime. The desktop folder is needed for copy-pasting files.. It's in the original MWB... But yes, I do wish the location was configurable or something under %USERPROFILE% or %LOCALAPPDATA% or yadda..
